title: Instance-ID cache (laptop, internal)
description: %USERPROFILE%\.agentspace\instance-id.json (D21, D40): the box's instance ID, cached from the stack's InstanceId output. Internal: written by deploy and by any operator command that finds it missing, read by every operator command but ca and by the ProxyCommand. A file that does not match this schema is treated as missing and rebuilt. Anchored patterns end with $(?!\n). See docs/state.md, "Files in the checkout".

version.description: The format's version. 0 until a change that an older reader would misread.

instance_id.description: The instance ID exactly as the stack's InstanceId output gives it.
